name: Travancore-Cochin
alt: United State of Travancore and Cochin

predecessors.name: Travancore
predecessors.text: Travancore as the travancore dossier draws it in 1949 (Kerala south of 10.2 N and the Kanyakumari country)

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Cochin
predecessors.text: Cochin as the kingdom-of-cochin dossier draws it in 1949 (Kochi, Thrissur and Chittur)

successors.name: Republic of India
successors.text: the whole state: Travancore-Cochin without the southern Tamil taluks, which joined Kerala, and those taluks, which went to Madras State, both states of India

ledger.x: 1 July 1949: Travancore and Cochin merge into one state.
1 July 1949: the Kingdom of Travancore is merged in.
1 July 1949: the Kingdom of Cochin is merged in.
1956: the southern Tamil taluks go to Madras State.
1 November 1956: Travancore-Cochin joins Malabar to form Kerala.

certainty.note: The edges are the princely states' boundaries; the southern frontier with Madras State was fixed by the 1956 transfer of taluks.
